name: Tisha Service Mode for WooCommerce
author: tishachalodiya

sections.description:
Service Booking Mode converts your WooCommerce products into a full service booking system.
Instead of adding products to the cart in the traditional way, users can book services directly from product pages.
Perfect for businesses offering appointments, services, or classes.

Features include:
* Converts WooCommerce products into bookable services
* On single service page added Address, Area, Note fields
* Admin panel for managing service mode settings
* Remove unnecessary fields like shipping, quantity and inventory, shipping Address
* Works seamlessly with your existing WooCommerce setup
sections.installation:
1. Upload the tisha-service-mode-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure your service booking settings under Service Booking Settings in the admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with all WooCommerce themes?

It should work with most themes, but custom themes may require minor CSS adjustments.

Can I use it for both products and services?

No, you can not choose which products are converted into services in the admin settings. But will look for it in future
